obligations.source_text: Definir o contrato que permitirá futuramente apresentar valores consolidados convertidos em uma moeda de referência, sem alterar a moeda nativa dos registros e sem conversão implícita.
obligations.rationale: The shared contract preserves native values and requires explicit, auditable conversion semantics instead of implicit cross-currency aggregation.

obligations.source_text: definir responsabilidade e ciclo de vida da eventual moeda de referência do perfil;
obligations.rationale: The contract documents an optional reference-currency preference with absent, defined, changed, and removed lifecycle states without persistence in this issue.

obligations.source_text: definir o shape do valor convertido: origem, destino, taxa, data/instante de referência e fonte;
obligations.rationale: ExchangeRateQuote and converted values expose source currency, target currency, decimal rate, reference instant, expiry, and source metadata.

obligations.source_text: definir comportamento quando cotação estiver ausente, expirada ou indisponível;
obligations.rationale: The shared availability contract distinguishes missing, expired, and unavailable quotes and fails closed without a converted amount.

obligations.source_text: definir como APIs e UI distinguem valor nativo de valor convertido;
obligations.rationale: The shared discriminated union exposes native, converted, and unavailable states for API/view-model consumers without local inference.

obligations.source_text: registrar ADR complementar se houver escolha de schema persistente ou provider.
obligations.rationale: The conditional ADR obligation is not triggered because this issue selects neither persistent schema nor an FX provider; ADR 0013 remains sufficient.

obligations.source_text: não existe suposição universal de BRL;
obligations.rationale: Reference currency is explicit and optional; no BRL or other universal fallback is introduced.

obligations.source_text: moeda de referência não altera a moeda nativa do registro;
obligations.rationale: Every converted representation retains the original native amount and currency alongside the reference currency.
Converted values require auditable quote metadata including pair, rate, reference instant, expiry, and source.

obligations.source_text: ausência de cotação não vira 1:1 nem zero;
obligations.rationale: Missing/unavailable/expired quotes never synthesize parity 1:1 or a zero converted amount.

obligations.source_text: contrato é consumível por Dashboard, Relatórios e futuras projeções;
obligations.rationale: Dashboard, Reports, and future projections are directed to one consumer-neutral shared representation.

obligations.source_text: não há integração externa nesta issue.
obligations.rationale: No provider, external network integration, migration, or runtime FX lookup is introduced by the material candidate.

obligations.source_text: escolher ou implementar provider de câmbio;
obligations.rationale: Selecting or implementing an FX provider is explicitly outside this issue and no provider is introduced.
Persisting complete exchange-rate history is explicitly outside this issue and no persistence change is introduced.
Consolidating the wealth UI is explicitly outside this issue and no UI route/component is changed.

structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: Currency source/target/native/reference fields are linked semantic values; native preservation and fail-closed conversion are structural invariants.

entries.plausible_wrong_implementation: A converted value could discard native money, accept an incompatible currency pair, or fabricate same-currency parity while still returning a superficially valid payload.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: The specification explicitly mentions exchange-rate history as out of scope, so the closure verifies that no historical read model or persistence contract is introduced.

entries.result: No quote-history storage, versioned query, pagination, or historical API is introduced; the obligation remains explicitly out of scope.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: The issue adds a single shared domain subpath and documentation contract; it does not create duplicated runtime catalogs or persisted canonical datasets.

documentation_consistency.applicability_reason: Living status, documentation index, ADR 0013, and the conversion contract consistently distinguish an implemented contract from a still-unimplemented provider/productive conversion.
old_contract_terms: future conversion contract not yet materialized

occurrences.result: Issue 596 contract is marked Feito without claiming productive FX conversion.
Documentation index exposes the currency conversion contract.
Normative contract defines explicit auditable conversion and preserves native values.
ADR requires explicit conversion and audit metadata and does not choose provider or default reference currency.
Native currencyBlocks remain canonical until explicit conversion is activated.

matches.detail: No persistent schema or provider is chosen, so no complementary ADR is required.
No provider, quote-history persistence, or wealth-UI consolidation is introduced.
